description: Declared mutants of the logging batch (docs/architecture/target/v2/logging-declaration.zh-Hant.md, section 9.4; ids lg-). Each guards a Design Invariant of target/v2/logging.zh-Hant.md (LG-1 to LG-11) or a section of the declaration; the de-duplication mutants of revision 1 are gone with the de-duplication itself (user, 2026-11-20, v8-arch-gyo2-logging-failure-log-then-exit). Run: python3 tests/common/mutation/run_mutations.py --build-dir build/target/_build/core --catalog tests/common/logging/mutations.json --cmake <cmake>
